title: Stable shell — the website is usable again
summary: YTIntel now boots through one stable entry layer instead of a chain of old runtime versions. Analyse, Competitors and Vault remain clickable on desktop and phone, and navigation stays responsive while a real analysis is running.
discord_changes: 🖱️ EVERY CORE SCREEN CLICKABLE: Analyse, Competitors and Vault now use one stable navigation owner on desktop and phone.
🧹 ONE CLEAN BOOT: removed the old multi-module startup chain from the shipped page so the UI no longer cycles through competing runtime layers.
📱 PHONE VERIFIED: 390px mobile navigation passed with no horizontal overflow and all three bottom-nav destinations working.
✅ REAL ANALYSE VERIFIED: the live Blake benchmark run completed all 17 sections to 100%, and navigation remained usable during the run.
changes: Replaced v360-entry.js and its long sequential module graph with v380-stable-shell.js as the only HTML script entry.
Kept the proven v340 zero-credit analysis core behind the stable shell instead of letting optional UI layers own navigation.
Made the app shell visible immediately and removed blocking onboarding/tour overlays from the stability path.
Restored visible Competitors controls and Vault content instead of keeping their containers hidden behind legacy anchor classes.
Locked the displayed release version to v0.38.0 so older core code cannot visually overwrite it during hydration.
Reset the service-worker cache contract to the minimal v0.38 stable asset set.
Added local browser smoke coverage for every top-level tab, Creator DNA saving, Competitor adding, phone navigation and a real 17-section analysis.
Added a production-browser smoke that repeats the same interaction flow against the actual GitHub Pages deployment.
known_limitations: v0.38 deliberately prioritises a dependable clickable website over the unfinished experimental v0.36/v0.37 feature layers.
Advanced Endgame media and multimodal features remain outside this stability release until they can be reintroduced without destabilising navigation.
Zero-credit evidence mode remains the current analysis engine; this release does not claim frontier paid-model parity.
why_it_matters: Before adding more intelligence, the product has to behave like a website: load once, let the user click things, move between screens, run an analysis and get back out without the shell fighting itself. v0.38 establishes that stable base.
